# si.v1 vocabulary

Canonical types for the Superintelligence Homepage's knowledge layer, the one source for every runtime. `npm run schema` generates JSON Schema, zod (Node/browser), pydantic (Python), protobuf with a gRPC service, Arrow (columnar, pyarrow), a JSON-LD context, OpenRPC (JSON-RPC) and Rust serde structs into schema/gen/. Field types: string, int, float, bool, datetime (ISO 8601 text), json (any), T[] (list), T? (optional), or another type's name. `ld` maps a field or type to a JSON-LD term (schema.org where one fits). Naming follows docs/NAMING.md: types are PascalCase, fields snake_case, ids qualified (namespace:id).

## Namespace

Namespaces of qualified ids (lib/ids.js)

`topic` · `org` · `benchmark` · `person` · `concept` · `req` · `module` · `source` · `story`

## TagMethod

How a tag was made

`ontology-term` · `entity` · `concept-term` · `embedding` · `rule` · `human`

## ScopeRule

Which part of the REQ-003 rule decided

`strong` · `topics` · `none`

## Tag

A label on a story or chunk that explains itself: what it is (qid), the words that matched, and how it was made. JSON-LD type: `schema:DefinedTerm`.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="qid"></a>`qid` | `string` | Qualified id, e.g. topic:alignment (`@id`) |
| <a id="label"></a>`label` | `string` | Readable label (`schema:name`) |
| <a id="matched"></a>`matched` | `string[]` | Words in the text that produced the tag |
| <a id="via"></a>`via` | `string?` | Child topic that implied this parent topic |
| <a id="method"></a>`method` | `TagMethod` | How the tag was made |
| <a id="score"></a>`score` | `float?` | Confidence 0-1 when the method gives one (embedding similarity) |

## ScopeDecision

REQ-003 verdict from lib/rules/scope.json.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="in"></a>`in` | `bool` | Shown in the superintelligence feed |
| <a id="rule"></a>`rule` | `ScopeRule` | Which branch decided |
| <a id="reason"></a>`reason` | `string` | Plain-language reason |
| <a id="term"></a>`term` | `string?` | The strong term that matched |
| <a id="topics"></a>`topics` | `string[]` | Top-level topic ids that matched |

## Story

One story, grouped across sources. JSON-LD type: `schema:NewsArticle`.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="id"></a>`id` | `int` | Row id; qualified as story:<id> |
| <a id="title"></a>`title` | `string` |  (`schema:headline`) |
| <a id="url"></a>`url` | `string` |  (`schema:url`) |
| <a id="summary"></a>`summary` | `string?` |  (`schema:abstract`) |
| <a id="published_at"></a>`published_at` | `datetime?` |  (`schema:datePublished`) |
| <a id="tags"></a>`tags` | `Tag[]` | Topics, organisations, benchmarks, people, concepts (`schema:about`) |
| <a id="scope"></a>`scope` | `ScopeDecision?` | Why it is (or isn't) in the feed |
| <a id="significance"></a>`significance` | `int?` | 0-100, explained in lib/analysis.js |

## Chunk

A passage of a story's text, the unit that gets tagged and embedded. JSON-LD type: `schema:CreativeWork`.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="story_id"></a>`story_id` | `int` |  (`schema:isPartOf`) |
| <a id="ord"></a>`ord` | `int` | Position in the story, from 0 |
| <a id="text"></a>`text` | `string` |  (`schema:text`) |
| <a id="hash"></a>`hash` | `string` | sha1 of the text, so unchanged chunks aren't redone |
| <a id="tags"></a>`tags` | `Tag[]` |  |

## Embedding

A vector for a chunk or concept. The default model is a free local hashing embedding; others can be plugged in as adapters.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="subject"></a>`subject` | `string` | What is embedded: chunk:<story>:<ord> or concept:<id> |
| <a id="model"></a>`model` | `string` | Adapter id, e.g. hash-256 |
| <a id="dims"></a>`dims` | `int` |  |
| <a id="vector"></a>`vector` | `float[]` |  |

## Edge

A link in the knowledge graph between two qualified ids, with the evidence for it.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="src"></a>`src` | `string` | Qualified id |
| <a id="rel"></a>`rel` | `string` | Relation, e.g. co-occurs, needs, part-of |
| <a id="dst"></a>`dst` | `string` | Qualified id |
| <a id="weight"></a>`weight` | `float` | Strength (co-occurring chunks, or 1 for curated links) |
| <a id="evidence"></a>`evidence` | `string[]` | Chunk or story ids that support it |
